# Brian Giannini

> Mobile & AI Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience across crypto hardware (Ledger), robotics (SoftBank Robotics), defense (Thales), IoT, and AI-native consumer apps. Founder of Criaphore, based in Paris, available for remote freelance consulting.

## Core Expertise
- Mobile Engineering: Cross-platform mobile (Kotlin Multiplatform), iOS & Android product architecture, Jetpack Compose, BLE/IoT/hardware integration, CI/CD
- AI Software Engineering: AI-native mobile products, LLM API integration & RAG, Model Context Protocol (MCP), WebMCP, agentic development workflows, multi-agent systems (Google ADK, Gemini, Veo)
- Consulting & Contact: brian@criaphore.com | [Malt](https://www.malt.fr/profile/briangiannini) | [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/briangiannini1/) | [GitHub](https://github.com/BrianGiannini) | [X](https://x.com/Sanguisan/)

## Pages
- [Home & Portfolio](https://briangiannini.com/): Overview of career history, freelance consulting services, and projects.
- [AI Second Brain](https://briangiannini.com/projects/ai-second-brain/): Personal knowledge base built on the LLM Wiki pattern, maintained by AI agents 24/7 on a home server and controlled from a phone.
- [The collaborative AI Gen TV](https://briangiannini.com/projects/collaborative-ai-gen-tv/): Live YouTube stream programmed by viewers via Google ADK multi-agent orchestration, Gemini 3, and Veo 3.1 on Google Cloud Run.
- [War4craft: Battle Realms](https://briangiannini.com/projects/war4craft/): StarCraft II custom mod importing World of Warcraft 3D models and Battle Realms mechanics, with gameplay videos and press coverage.
- [Travel Map](https://briangiannini.com/travels/): Interactive 2D map and 3D globe of countries and regions visited by Brian Giannini.

## Selected Products & Work
- [Criaphore](https://criaphore.com/): Solo software studio building AI-native mobile applications (including [Orbora](https://criaphore.com/orbora) and [Diagnosly](https://criaphore.com/diagnosly)).
- [Freelance Consulting](https://www.malt.fr/profile/briangiannini): Mobile & AI Software Engineering consulting (2025 - Present).
- [Ledger Atom](https://shop.ledger.com/pages/ledger-atom): Hardware wallet security & mobile integration (2022 - 2024).
- [SoftBank Robotics](https://us.softbankrobotics.com/pepper): Mobile software for Pepper humanoid robot and Plato food-service robot (2019 - 2022).
- [Thales](https://www.thalesgroup.com/): Tactical special-forces mobile apps, French Army SIA C2 command system, and biometric ID verification (2015 - 2019).

## AI Agent Interaction (WebMCP & JSON)
This website supports WebMCP (Model Context Protocol for the Web) on the homepage:
- `searchPortfolio`: Search Brian's work, projects, and personal pages by keyword.
- `getHireInfo`: Get structured freelance availability, services, location, and contact links.
- `contactForFreelance`: Declarative form tool to draft a freelance inquiry email to brian@criaphore.com.
